'''The Drop Out Jawas and Jedi and Pods, Oh My!! (AITC)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Drop Out]]
* '''Published:''' 24 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Court Out LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A fun little jawa deck to toy around with.

== Strategy ==

How to play:

1. Use the Audience Chamber game text to pull Bo Shuda ASAP. With Uh-Oh! out you should be pretty safe from the opponent there (beware of Sniper and Bubo).

2. Use You Will Take Me To Jabba Now to pull Tessek (adds to drains), Geezum (pulls sites), Lando w/Ax (excluding power), Kalit (canceling power with Obj and power boost to jawas), Thedit (powerhouse when with two other jawas).

3. You use Geezum to pull your sites: Slave Quarters pulls Shmi, who pulls Threepio WHPS and City Outskirts pulls a Jedi (three to choose from).

4. R'kik with the Ion Gun RULES!!  Let your opponent play with the destroyer droids, your destiny will be plus four which means THERE IS NO WAY YOU WILL MISS.  The destroyer droids CAN BE STOLEN!!!!!!!

Once your set up, you will be draining for a ton between your sabers and Tessek. And when you've got Underworld Contacts out, the opponent will be hard pressed to stop you.
